researchScope: Xiaomi MiMo first-party PAYG API and China/Singapore/Europe Token Plan

comparisonPolicy.tokenPlanRates: plan price divided by included Credits, multiplied by the published model Credits per token
comparisonPolicy.annualPlans: annual price and annual Credits; already reflects the advertised 0.88 annual multiplier
comparisonPolicy.firstPurchaseDiscount: stored as metadata; base comparable rate remains the repeatable list-price rate
comparisonPolicy.offPeakDiscount: stored as 0.8 Credit-consumption metadata; base comparable rate remains the all-hours rate
